description: Nine development and three held-out independently generatable Scene Write cases. Each category exercises one failure mode and checks for side effects from other addenda.

cases.focus: The water remains completely still while light, people, and sound supply density.
fidelity_checks: Pool water is explicitly motionless with an undisturbed surface
No water ripples, drops, or splashes introduced
The scene remains visually/audio rich without requiring action

history.content: The water is still for the entire shot. The environmental density should come from the atmosphere.

project.title: Empty Pool
project.style: Dusky cyan and sodium amber, rich distant sound.

cases.instruction: Write one 12-second H3 Scene: a fixed view of an abandoned indoor pool at blue hour. The pool water has a perfectly still, unbroken surface throughout. Reflections of cracked ceiling tiles stay clear. Distant ventilation, a faint electrical hum, and a low city rumble make the moment sonically textured. No character appears.

cases.focus: The umbrella is already inside-out before the first frame; this state persists.
fidelity_checks: First shot establishes red umbrella already inside-out
Bent ribs stay bent
Rain, person, roof and sound remain coherent

history.content: The previous clip ended with the red umbrella inverted by the wind.

existingScenes.title: Inside-out
existingScenes.prompt: The red umbrella turns inside-out in a gust. Ribs bend visibly.

previousScene.title: Inside-out
previousScene.prompt: The red umbrella turns inside-out in a gust. Ribs bend visibly.

cases.instruction: Write one 8-second continuation Scene independently generatable. From its first frame the same person is already holding the red umbrella inside-out, with its damaged ribs visibly bent. They struggle to collapse the inverted canopy while wind and rain batter the roof.

cases.focus: An explicitly closed door remains closed while activity occurs elsewhere.
fidelity_checks: The wooden door is explicitly closed at the start
The door stays shut for the whole clip
Activity comes from shadows, foliage, wind and sound

history.content: The closed door is the central image; I don't want a reveal.

cases.instruction: Write one 15-second observational H3 Scene centered on a weathered wooden door latched shut for the whole clip. Tree shadows move across it, leaves stir nearby and a passing bicycle bell sounds beyond the courtyard. The door remains motionless and closed throughout.

cases.focus: Exactly 6 consecutive 2-second shots across a 12-second montage.
fidelity_checks: Exactly six labeled shots
Each shot is 2s long
Shots cover 0s to 12s contiguously
Each shot has tactile image and appropriate sound

history.content: A very fast, tactile macro montage of careful watch repair.

cases.instruction: Write one 12-second H3 Scene as exactly six 2-second shots. The six shots, in order: tweezers lift a screw, an oiled gear meshes, a hand steadies a wheel, a spring settles, the second hand jumps, the finished watch clicks shut. Each has synchronized fine mechanical audio.

cases.focus: Eight consecutive 1-second shots with distinct images and sound.
fidelity_checks: Eight 1s labeled shots
Shot intervals span 0s to 8s without gaps
Specified espresso actions follow order
Fine synchronized sounds accent each cut

history.content: The editing itself should feel like percussion.

cases.instruction: Write an 8-second H3 espresso Scene, exactly eight 1-second cuts in this order: hand grips portafilter, coffee grinds, grounds level, tamper presses, basket locks, pump clicks, dark stream begins, crema swirls. Make each sound match its image.

cases.focus: Five 2-second shots with simple visual beats and clear rhythmic audio.
fidelity_checks: Exactly five 2s intervals
They span 0s to 10s
Specified plant/soil imagery appears
Sound accents associate with the shots

history.content: I want 2-second cuts, not five lingering shots.

cases.instruction: Write one 10-second H3 Scene as exactly five 2-second shots: soil cracks apart in fingers, a small seed falls, a narrow hole is pressed, soil closes over it, water pours into the bed. Synchronize small sound details with each cut.

cases.focus: Both precise lines are tagged as spoken text, with correct speaker separation.
fidelity_checks: Both original lines preserved exactly
Spoken words are inside <d> tags and speaker labels outside
Every <d> has a matching </d>
Timing fits clip duration

history.content: Their dialogue is the heart of this Scene.

project.title: The Crossing
project.style: Natural light and quiet river sound.

invariants.title: Mara
invariants.text: Woman with short grey hair and red scarf.

cases.instruction: Write one 10-second Scene on a dawn ferry. Mara asks exactly 'You still remember the bridge?' A man answers exactly 'Every time it rains.' Assign distinct voices, restrained performances and subtle engine rumble.

cases.focus: One complete whispered sentence in one H3 tag with the actual words inside.
fidelity_checks: Exact whisper preserved
The spoken line appears inside one complete <d>...</d> tag
Speaker description and whisper performance outside the tag

history.content: Her words have to be heard precisely.

cases.instruction: Write one 7-second single-shot H3 Scene of a teenager in a dim hallway whispering exactly 'I hid the key under the blue bowl.' Include her breathy delivery, soft fabric rustle and quiet house ambience.

cases.focus: Two speakers exchange exact lines in order, with a clear interruption.
fidelity_checks: Both lines preserved exactly and in order
Speaker IDs distinguish the lines
Spoken words live inside complete H3 tags
Delivery and timing match interruption

history.content: The second line interrupts the first speaker.

project.title: Late Call
project.concept: Two siblings on a voice call.

cases.instruction: Write one 12-second H3 Scene: younger sibling says exactly 'I thought you'd never call again.' Older sibling interrupts with exactly 'I called every Sunday.' Give both distinct voices and timed cuts with subtle phone audio.

cases.focus: A post-break physical condition remains visible from the opening frame.
fidelity_checks: First frame already shows cracked lantern glass
Crack remains visible through the shot
Lantern stays unlit as requested

history.content: Previous Scene ended with the lantern glass cracking and its flame going out.

project.title: Last Light
project.concept: Clips about a cold mountain trail.

existingScenes.title: Break
existingScenes.prompt: A lantern hits a rock. Its glass cracks and flame goes out.

previousScene.title: Break
previousScene.prompt: A lantern hits a rock. Its glass cracks and flame goes out.

cases.instruction: Create one 9-second continuation Scene. From the opening frame the lantern's glass is already cracked and its wick is unlit. A hiker picks it up and examines the crack as wind scatters pine needles across the path. Keep the lantern dark for the whole Scene.

cases.focus: Six 2-second contrasting images fill a 12-second sequence without timing collisions.
fidelity_checks: Exactly six shots, each 2s
Continuous intervals 0–12s
Every specified image is present in order
Each sound lands in its corresponding shot

history.content: The rhythm is exactly two seconds per cut.

cases.instruction: Write one 12-second H3 montage with six 2-second shots: ticket stamp, train-wheel detail, swinging clock pendulum, hand touching cold railing, paper ticket in pocket, platform lamp flickering. Give each shot its own sync sound.

cases.focus: Exact separate spoken lines, one English and one French, with speaker identity and tag scope.
fidelity_checks: Line 1 exact English text inside <d> tag
Line 2 exact French text inside a different <d> tag
Language labels and speakers distinct
Every tag closes correctly

history.content: Do the scene bilingually and keep each speaker's wording.

cases.instruction: Write one 11-second H3 Scene. A woman with a yellow scarf says exactly in English 'The last train is gone.' An older man responds exactly in French 'Alors, nous marcherons.' Use separate voice identities, accurate language markers and a few quiet reaction shots.
